title: 非标定制方案沟通
titleEn: Custom Design: From Renderings to CAD Drawings

intro.visual: 整园设计流程图 + 3D效果图对比
intro.background: 温尚的核心竞争力是非标定制（Custom Non-standard Design）。整园设计流程6步：客户接洽→方案沟通→现场测量→设计定制→生产运输→安装验收。户外大型玩具5个工作日出3D效果图，最多3轮修改。室内功能教室根据面积和年龄段出布局图+产品清单。客户经常会说：I want something unique / Can you match our school colors / We have an irregular site。你要能用英语引导客户走完定制流程，而不是只会说yes we can。
intro.desc: 掌握非标定制的完整流程、沟通话术和方案确认技巧。
tasks: 学会引导客户提供设计输入
掌握方案确认和修改话术
outcomes: 能独立引导客户走定制流程
能用英语讨论3D方案修改
能高效确认方案进入报价

oneLiner.en: Custom design is a six-step process: consultation, concept discussion, site survey, 3D rendering, production, installation — not just saying yes to every request.
oneLiner.cn: 非标定制是六步流程：接洽、方案沟通、现场测量、3D设计、生产、安装——不是对每个要求都说yes。

vocab.ex: Could you share your design brief — age group, budget and preferred theme?
vocab.exCn: 您能分享设计需求吗——年龄段、预算和偏好主题？

mistakes.wrong: Yes, we can make anything you want. Just tell us what you need.
mistakes.right: We can customize based on your site. To start, could you share the site dimensions, age group, budget range and preferred theme? We will then deliver a 3D rendering within 5 working days.
mistakes.cn: 错误：什么都说能做，不引导客户提供信息。专业做法是主动收集设计输入：场地尺寸、年龄段、预算、主题偏好。

mistakes.wrong: The design is perfect, no changes needed.
mistakes.right: Here is the first rendering. Please review and let us know any adjustments — we include up to 3 revision rounds. Once confirmed, we will proceed to CAD shop drawings and quotation.
mistakes.cn: 错误：不让客户提修改意见。要主动邀请反馈，说明包含3轮修改，确认后才进入CAD和报价。

advanced.en: Our custom design process follows six stages: client consultation, concept discussion, on-site measurement, 3D rendering with up to 3 revisions, CAD shop drawing finalization, and production with installation guidance — a dedicated designer is assigned to your project throughout.
advanced.cn: 我们的定制设计流程分六阶段：客户接洽、方案沟通、现场测量、3D效果图（含3轮修改）、CAD施工图定稿、生产及安装指导——全程指派专属设计师。
advanced.from: We can customize the design based on your site.

advanced.en: To prepare an accurate proposal, could you provide: 1) site plan or dimensions with photos, 2) age group and number of children, 3) budget range, 4) preferred theme or brand colors, 5) any site constraints like trees or slopes? This ensures our first rendering hits the mark.
advanced.cn: 为了准备精准方案，您能提供：1）场地平面图或尺寸+照片，2）年龄段和孩子数量，3）预算范围，4）偏好主题或品牌色，5）场地限制如树木或坡度？这确保我们第一版效果图就切中需求。

dialogues.title: 引导客户提供设计输入

lines.speaker: client
lines.en: We want a custom playground design. Can you do something unique for us?
lines.cn: 我们想要定制游乐设施。能做个独一无二的吗？

lines.speaker: you
lines.en: Absolutely. To make the design truly unique and fit your site, I need a few details first: the site dimensions and photos, the age group, your budget range, and any theme or color preferences. With these, our designer will deliver a 3D rendering within 5 working days.
lines.cn: 当然。为了让设计真正独特且贴合场地，我先需要几个信息：场地尺寸和照片、年龄段、预算范围、主题或颜色偏好。有了这些，我们设计师5个工作日出3D效果图。

lines.speaker: client
lines.en: The site is about 200 sqm with a big tree in the middle. Kids are 3 to 6. We like forest theme.
lines.cn: 场地约200平米，中间有棵大树。3-6岁。我们喜欢森林主题。

lines.speaker: you
lines.en: Perfect — a tree in the middle is actually a great feature. We can design a Forest Adventure treehouse structure that wraps around the tree, with a slide, climbing net and a small playhouse. I will assign a dedicated designer and send the first 3D rendering in 5 days. Up to 3 revisions are included.
lines.cn: 太好了——中间有棵树其实是很棒的特色。我们可以设计一套绿野寻踪树屋设施绕树而建，配滑梯、攀爬网和小游戏屋。我指派专属设计师，5天内发第一版3D效果图。包含最多3轮修改。

scenario.q: A client says: We want something special for our kindergarten, the site is irregular with a slope. How do you respond and guide them?
scenario.modelAnswer: An irregular site with a slope is actually a great opportunity for a unique design — we specialize in this. To start, could you share: 1) site photos and approximate dimensions, 2) age group and number of children, 3) budget range, 4) any theme preferences? Our designer will work with the slope to create multi-level play structures rather than fighting the terrain. We will deliver a 3D rendering within 5 working days, with up to 3 revision rounds. Once confirmed, we provide CAD shop drawings and a detailed quotation.
scenario.cn: 不规则带坡度的场地其实是做独特设计的好机会——我们正好擅长这个。首先，您能提供：1）场地照片和大致尺寸，2）年龄段和孩子数量，3）预算范围，4）主题偏好吗？我们的设计师会顺应坡度做多层游乐设施，而不是硬推平。5个工作日出3D效果图，含3轮修改。确认后提供CAD施工图和详细报价。

culture.title: 定制沟通中的主动权
culture.content: 很多外贸新人在定制沟通中处于被动：客户说什么就yes，最后改了8轮还不满意。专业做法是掌握主动权：第一步就收集完整设计输入（场地、年龄、预算、主题、限制），第二步承诺明确交付时间（5天3D），第三步限定修改轮次（3轮），第四步确认后才报价。这样既专业又保护自己的时间。温尚的设计师资源有限，每个项目都要珍惜——会引导客户的业务员，设计师更愿意配合。
